channel.title: Home Picks Under $30
channel.description: Simple, useful kitchen and home gadgets that save you time

item.title: Emergency Kit Essentials Under $30: What Governments Recommend and What to Buy
item.description: Emergency kit essentials under $30, based on what the US, UK, EU, Nordic countries and Japan now advise: water, light, power, a radio, warmth, documents and safety.

item.title: Hostess Gifts Under $30 for Someone Who Loves to Cook
item.description: Hostess gifts under $30 for the person hosting holiday dinner: things to use at the table that night, tools for a host who cooks every day, and dessert helpers.

item.title: Kitchen Gifts for a College Student or New Cook Under $30: Dorm and First Apartment Picks
item.description: Kitchen gifts for a college student or new cook under $30, sorted by their setup: a dorm with only a microwave, lunch on the go, a first apartment with a stove, and hot drinks.

item.title: Best Kitchen Gadgets Under $30: 10 Picks That Fix Everyday Kitchen Problems
item.description: The best kitchen gadgets under $30, one for each everyday problem: dry chicken, slow chopping, a tiny kitchen, soggy leftovers, rushed breakfasts, cooking for one, coffee, work lunches, movie night and baking.

item.title: White Elephant and Secret Santa Kitchen Gifts Under $30 That Get Stolen
item.description: White elephant and Secret Santa kitchen gifts under $30, sorted by the kind of exchange: coworkers you barely know, a steal-happy family game, and the dorm or break-room crowd.

item.title: Gifts for Bakers Under $30: One Pick for Every Kind of Baker
item.description: Gifts for bakers under $30, sorted by the kind of baker: the Christmas cookie baker, the decorator, the bread baker, the one with scorched oven mitts, and the baker who wants a fun project.

item.title: Gifts for a Coffee Lover Under $30: One Pick for Every Kind of Coffee Drinker
item.description: Gifts for a coffee lover under $30, sorted by how they drink it: latte lover, pour-over fan, commuter or desk worker, and Keurig owner.

item.title: Stocking Stuffers for People Who Cook: 4 Grab-and-Go Bundles, Each Item Under $30
item.description: Stocking stuffers for people who cook, sorted into four ready-made bundles of small kitchen tools, each item under $30: the everyday cook, the baker, the lunch packer and parents or grandparents.

item.title: Kitchen Gifts Under $30, Sorted by Who You're Shopping For (2026)
item.description: Useful kitchen gifts under $30 for Christmas, grouped by who you're shopping for: home cooks, holiday bakers, solo cooks, students, lunch packers and coffee drinkers.

item.title: Thanksgiving Mashed Potatoes and Gravy: 6 Small Tools Under $30
item.description: A potato ricer, a bottom-release gravy separator, a stick blender and three more small tools under $30 for smooth mash and gravy that isn't greasy or lumpy.

item.title: Make-Ahead Halloween Party Treats: 6 Kitchen Gadgets Under $30
item.description: Halloween molds, cookie cutters, a chocolate melting pot and candy apple supplies under $30, plus a simple day-before party plan for trick-or-treat night.

item.title: One Oven on Thanksgiving? Gadgets Under $30 for Oven-Free Sides
item.description: One small oven and a turkey that fills it? Move one or two sides to a steamer basket and a small slow cooker, check the turkey with a thermometer, and follow a simple day-of timeline.

item.title: Making Treats With Kids: Mini Donut and Waffle Gadgets Under $30 (With an Age-by-Age Guide)
item.description: Mini donut maker, donut pan and mini waffle maker picks under $30, plus what kids aged 3 to 5, 6 to 8 and 9+ can actually help with and a simple Saturday-morning plan.

item.title: Movie Night at Home: Popcorn Gadgets and Snack Tools That Keep You on the Couch
item.description: Movie night snack gadgets under $30: a microwave popcorn popper or a hot air popper (pick by crowd size), a seasoning sampler and a snack tray.

item.title: Load It and Walk Away: Hands-Off Kitchen Gadgets Under $30
item.description: Hands-off kitchen gadgets under $30 that cook while you shower, work or commute: two rice cookers, a small slow cooker, a 12-cup coffee maker and a microwave pasta bowl.

item.title: Pack It the Night Before: Lunch Containers and Bags Under $30 for Work
item.description: A good work lunch box and lunch food containers for packing the night before: 2-compartment boxes, a bento box, a salad kit, an insulated bag, slim ice packs and a utensil set, all under $30.

item.title: Hot Lunch at Your Desk: Microwave Gadgets Under $30 for the Office Break Room
item.description: Five microwave gadgets under $30 for a hot lunch in the office break room: a pasta bowl, a ramen cooker, a microwave sandwich press, egg molds and a lidded grill pan.

item.title: Cooking for One: 5 Small Kitchen Gadgets Under $30 That Fit One Person
item.description: Five small kitchen gadgets under $30 sized for one person: a 2-cup rice cooker, a mini waffle maker, an 8-inch pan, an egg patty maker and a ramen cooker, with who each suits.

item.title: Coffee-Shop Breakfast at Home: 2 Small Kits for Egg Sandwiches and Foamy Coffee
item.description: Two small gadget kits for a coffee-shop breakfast at home: a microwave-only egg sandwich kit and a café coffee kit, all under $30.

item.title: No Stove? 4 Microwave Gadgets and a Week of Real Meals
item.description: Cheap microwave meals with no stove, for a dorm, studio or rental: four microwave gadgets under $30 for eggs, bacon, burgers and grilled cheese, plus a Monday to Friday menu.

item.title: Cooking Without Guesswork: 4 Kitchen Gadgets Under $30 That Tell You When Food Is Done
item.description: An instant-read thermometer, a kitchen scale, an oven thermometer and a timer set, all under $30, plus a USDA safe-temperature cheat sheet so you stop cutting into dinner to check.

item.title: Leftover Rescue: Kitchen Gadgets Under $30 to Store, Freeze and Reheat Last Night's Dinner
item.description: Kitchen gadgets under $30 for leftovers: one clear pick each for storing, freezing single portions and reheating, plus who should skip what.

item.title: Chop, Peel, Prep Faster: 6 Kitchen Gadgets Under $30 That Take Over the Knife Work
item.description: Six kitchen gadgets under $30 that speed up chopping, peeling and mincing on weeknights, plus the order to buy them in and who should skip each one.

item.title: Quick Breakfast Gadgets Under $30: A Sunday Prep, Weekday Grab Routine
item.description: Kitchen gadgets under $30 for quick breakfasts you prep on Sunday: jars for overnight oats, egg bite molds, a mason jar pitcher and egg rings, each picked for one job.

item.title: Kitchen Gadgets for Small Kitchens Under $30 That Fold, Nest or Disappear
item.description: Space-saving kitchen gadgets under $30 for apartments and rentals: a collapsible colander, nesting bowls, flexible cutting mats, a roll-up drying rack and more.

item.title: Meal Prep Sunday Made Fast: Kitchen Gadgets Under $30 That Do the Boring Work
item.description: Kitchen gadgets under $30 for Sunday meal prep: a pull chopper, glass containers, a scale, freezer trays and a big cutting board, with who each one suits.

item.title: Kitchen Gadgets Under $30 That Get Weeknight Dinner Done Faster
item.description: One pick per weeknight job: garlic, slicing, grating, cutting, greens, doneness and prep. Small kitchen tools under $30 that cut minutes off dinner.
